fields.statement: At b86358b9 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestWatchdog (all PASS, incl. TestWatchdogPRNoCI 1.86s), go test ./internal/daemon (ok) and go vet on both. TestWatchdogPRNoCI uses local bare repos as fake git remotes and a fake gh PR read: a clean merge of origin/main is pushed with a plain push (no --force, no rebase; origin's branch equals the pushed merge commit on top of the old head) and recorded as Pushed in the ship state; a conflicting merge is aborted with HEAD, worktree and origin's branch unchanged and no ship state written; the pass resumes a run whose workflow has conflict handling and holds an InboxStalled item for one without. Read the diff: the attempt-1 finding (merge before budget/hold checks) is fixed: watchdogPRNoCI now keeps an earlier hold for the same PR head and journal end without fetching, merging or logging (NoCIHead/NoCIAt/NoCIConflicts in daemon.WatchdogRun), and with the budget spent holds without merging, logging once; the new test cases cover both and a new head merges again.
